review.scope: Initial eight-page PUBLIC static regression budget, inspected against actual Chromium axe findings; not WCAG conformance or owner acceptance of these defects.
review.backlog: 144 existing node findings: 12 serious dataset contrast failures, one critical unlabeled testimony select, and 131 heading/landmark semantics findings. Repair source templates with their owners, remove resolved entries, then extend scope. No rule exclusions.
review.matching: Exact page, rule, selector and failure message. Changed contrast values and added failing nodes are regressions. No automatic baseline update command.
review.limitations: Desktop initial static rendered state only. No backend, remote resources, interaction, keyboard/screen-reader or full-site claim.

failures.heading-order:
Fix any of the following:
  Heading order invalid
failures.landmark-no-duplicate-contentinfo:
Fix any of the following:
  Document has more than one contentinfo landmark
failures.landmark-one-main:
Fix all of the following:
  Document does not have a main landmark
failures.landmark-unique:
Fix any of the following:
  The landmark must have a unique aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title to make landmarks distinguishable
failures.region:
Fix any of the following:
  Some page content is not contained by landmarks
failures.color-contrast:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.12 (foreground color: #eaf2fc, background color: #ffffff, font size: 11.0pt (14.72px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
failures.select-name:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
  Element does not have an explicit <label>
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
